boundary.name: Basel-Stadt canton
boundary.modifications: Extracted canton feature from checksum-verified GeoPackage; dropped Z ordinates for planar selection; coordinates otherwise unchanged

buffer.selection: Tiles intersecting the canton or a conservative L-infinity expansion; includes every tile intersecting the Euclidean buffer
buffer.height_and_low_sun_policy: 250m is a planning envelope, not a verified city maximum. T8/T10 must account for terrain relief along rays as well as object height; extend coverage or mark unknown when actual ray reach exceeds available geometry. Below 10 degrees, mark unsupported/unknown; night is a separate state.
buffer.missing_buffer_policy: Receiver cells whose sunward ray reaches absent or NoData geometry remain unknown

vertical_reference: LN02 / EPSG:5728; inspect per-asset header metadata

selection_method: Followed all next links in bounded STAC queries enclosing extent and buffer. Planar point-in-polygon plus segment/rectangle clipping selects intersecting 1km tiles; expand rectangles by 1500m to conservatively enclose a Euclidean buffer. Select latest nominal datetime among available 0.5m EPSG:2056/EPSG:5728 assets per tile, retain version alternatives. Nominal year does not prove exact survey date. No cross-border infill fabricated.
validation_scope: All 225 available asset headers accessed by bounded HTTP 206 requests; grids and tile origins verified. Four full representative pairs downloaded and checksum-verified. Full-city NoData, scene consistency, alignment on a rendered map, seams and halo decoding are T8 checks, not proven by header availability.
